integrity: Proof rests on a general shellability theorem, pointwise simplicial isotropy, Armstrong orbit-space theorem, Euler characteristics, Whitehead and Bockstein; finite exact orbit-chain checks independently corroborate n=5..12.
scientific_limitations: Even-width quotients are not given complete homotopy decompositions; only π1, integral homology, a mod-two product and normalized category are determined. Other row symmetries are excluded. Earlier unindexed equivalent results remain possible.
title: Dihedral parity and integral topology of three-row chessboard quotients
